const pattern = $json.pattern;
const recipes = Array.isArray(pattern.pattern_recipes) ? pattern.pattern_recipes : [];
const learningRows = Array.isArray(pattern.pattern_performance) ? pattern.pattern_performance : [];
const source = {
  pattern: {
    id: pattern.id,
    batch_id: pattern.batch_id,
    competitor_video_id: pattern.competitor_video_id,
    hook_pattern: pattern.hook_pattern,
    visual_pattern: pattern.visual_pattern,
    scenario_pattern: pattern.scenario_pattern,
    retention_pattern: pattern.retention_pattern,
    desire_trigger: pattern.desire_trigger,
    proof_pattern: pattern.proof_pattern,
    audio_pattern: pattern.audio_pattern,
    cta_pattern: pattern.cta_pattern,
    adaptation_recipe: pattern.adaptation_recipe,
    forbidden_elements_json: pattern.forbidden_elements_json || [],
    caution_elements_json: pattern.caution_elements_json || [],
    pattern_score: pattern.pattern_score,
    virality_score: pattern.virality_score,
    premium_score: pattern.premium_score,
    similarity_score: pattern.similarity_score
  },
  recipes: recipes.map(r => ({
    id: r.id,
    recipe_type: r.recipe_type,
    title: r.title,
    first_frame_formula: r.first_frame_formula,
    scene_formula_json: r.scene_formula_json || [],
    screen_text_formula: r.screen_text_formula,
    audio_formula: r.audio_formula,
    cta_formula: r.cta_formula,
    what_to_keep_json: r.what_to_keep_json || [],
    what_to_change_json: r.what_to_change_json || [],
    what_not_to_copy_json: r.what_not_to_copy_json || [],
    usable_for_products_json: r.usable_for_products_json || [],
    score: r.score
  })),
  learning: learningRows.slice(0, 12).map(x => ({
    views_multiplier: x.views_multiplier,
    engagement_score: x.engagement_score,
    lead_score: x.lead_score,
    learning_result: x.learning_result,
    weight_delta: x.weight_delta,
    notes: x.notes
  }))
};
const schema = {
  reels: [{
    group: 'close|viral|premium',
    number: 1,
    first_frame: '',
    hook_text: '',
    screen_text_json: [],
    scene_plan_json: [],
    caption: '',
    cta: '',
    viral_mechanism: '',
    source_pattern_preserved_json: [],
    uniqueness_moves_json: [],
    borrowed_elements_json: [],
    changed_elements_json: [],
    forbidden_checks_json: [],
    render_notes: '',
    ai_video_prompt: ''
  }],
  stories: [{
    number: 1,
    first_frame: '',
    hook_text: '',
    screen_text_json: [],
    scene_plan_json: [],
    caption: '',
    cta: '',
    viral_mechanism: '',
    borrowed_elements_json: [],
    changed_elements_json: [],
    forbidden_checks_json: []
  }],
  captions: [{ group: 'close|viral|premium', caption: '', cta: '', hook_text: '' }]
};
const system = [
  'You are the top strategist of a viral content factory for premium custom tables.',
  'Your job is not to invent random ideas. Your job is to transfer the competitor video mechanism into unique, usable, high-retention content.',
  'Be concrete enough that an editor/render workflow can make the video without asking questions.',
  'Text fields must be Russian. Return only valid JSON.'
].join(' ');
const user = [
  'Generate a production-ready content bank from this competitor-derived pattern.',
  'Main goal: maximum views, retention, virality and leads. Premium feel is important, but virality is priority #1.',
  'Need exactly 12 Reels: 4 close_to_competitor, 4 more_viral, 4 more_premium.',
  'Map groups exactly as: close, viral, premium. In each group use 4 different first-frame mechanics, not just different wording.',
  'Need exactly 4 Story ideas tied to the same pattern.',
  'Need exactly 3 captions/CTA: one close, one viral, one premium. First paragraph must make people keep reading.',
  'For close variants: preserve timing, emotion, scene logic and hook mechanism, but change words, product, framing, branding and execution.',
  'For viral variants: push stronger first 1-2 seconds, conflict/curiosity/proof/payoff, but keep the source pattern readable.',
  'For premium variants: make the table feel expensive, custom, desirable and gift/status-worthy without becoming boring.',
  'Respect learning notes: increase what worked, decrease what failed, but never kill an extreme viral mechanism only because it is less premium.',
  'Forbidden: exact copied text, exact copied frame, third-party logo as key element, face/person as key element, generic motivation, weak CTA, vague scene plan.',
  'If competitor uses hands/install/body without face, you may keep that type of visual as a safe pattern.',
  'Every reel must include source_pattern_preserved_json, uniqueness_moves_json, render_notes, and ai_video_prompt. ai_video_prompt must be useful only if WF03.5 later chooses ai_video.',
  'Return JSON matching this shape:',
  JSON.stringify(schema),
  'SOURCE:',
  JSON.stringify(source)
].join('\n');
return [{
  json: {
    pattern_id: pattern.id,
    batch_id: pattern.batch_id,
    competitor_video_id: pattern.competitor_video_id,
    recipes,
    learningRows,
    polza_body: {
      model: 'openai/gpt-5.2',
      messages: [{ role: 'system', content: system }, { role: 'user', content: user }],
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      temperature: 0.45
    }
  }
}];
return [{ json: { action: 'variant_generation_failed', error: $json.error || 'Unknown WF03 generation error' } }];
return [{ json: { action: 'skip', message: 'No generated-ready patterns are waiting for WF03.' } }];
